summary_en: ¥130/share annual dividend (¥10 increase from prior ¥120 forecast). Interim and full-year earnings upgraded on stronger operating profit, currency tailwinds, and cost improvements. Payout reflects better-than-expected FY3/27 performance.
title_en: Notice regarding revisions to FY2027 Q2 interim and full-year earnings forecasts and dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: Okamoto Industries revised its FY3/27 full-year dividend forecast upward by ¥10 per share, from ¥120 to ¥130. The company also upgraded interim (Q2, first half) and full-year earnings on stronger-than-expected operating and net profit. The revision reflects sustained currency tailwinds (yen weakness versus initial budget), strong order intake and pricing actions in industrial products, and lower antimony costs that had pressured prior-year profit. The company stated that improved business conditions are expected to continue for a period. The dividend increase is grounded in the company's capital allocation policy of balancing stable, continuous distributions with performance-linked payouts, while maintaining internal reserves for future growth and financial strengthening.
